==Purpose==
This infobox is derived from {{Tl|StarshipClass}} for use on specific examples of a class. {{Tl|StarshipClass}} should only be used on ship class articles.

==Usage instructions==
Cut and paste the following code into your article, then put the relevant specifications after the "=" signs.
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{IndividualShip
|image=
|name=
|designer=
|manufacturer=
|line=
|model=

|cost=

|length=

==Data fields==
*image &ndash; Put a link to a clear, preferably forward facing image of the ship.
*name &ndash; Put the name of the ship. Use italics for proper names, but not for conjectural names.
*designer &ndash; Identify the designer of the vessel (unique or one-off ships only).
*manufacturer &ndash; Identify the manufacturer of the vessel.
*line &ndash; Put the product line or series the ship's model belongs to. For example, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] is of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] line.
*model &ndash; Put the full name of the vessel's model (usually ends with "-class"). For example, the ''[[Relentless]]'' is an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].
*type &ndash; List the primary type classification of the ship's model. For example, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] is of the [[Star Destroyer]] type.
*cost &ndash; Put how much the ship cost.
*modifier &ndash; List (with bullets, if multiple) the people/organizations who have modified the ship.
*sysmods &ndash; List (with bullets, if multiple) the systems known to be modified.
*length &ndash; Length of the ship.
*width &ndash; Width of the ship.
*height &ndash; Height of the ship.
*mass &ndash; Mass of the ship.
*max accel &ndash; Maximum acceleration in "g".
*mglt &ndash; Maximum speed in MGLT.
*max speed &ndash; Maximum atmospheric speed.
*maneuverability &ndash; Maneuverability rating.
*engine &ndash; Type and number of sublight and atmospheric drive systems.
*hyperdrive &ndash; If the ship had a hyperdrive system ("Equipped" or "None"). Use only if the type or range is not known.
*hdrange &ndash; The range of the ship's hyperdrive. For example, "Class 2".
*hdsystem &ndash; The full name of the ship's hyperdrvie system.
*poweroutput &ndash; Power output in watts.
*power &ndash; Types of power systems.
*shield gen &ndash; Type of shield generators (with rating if known).
*hull &ndash; Type of hull materials (with rating if known).
*sensor &ndash; Types of sensor systems.
*target &ndash; Types of targeting systems.
*navigation &ndash; Navigation computer systems.
*avionics &ndash; Avionics/flight control systems.
*maincomp &ndash; Main computer system.
*countermeasures &ndash; Passive offensive or defensive systems such as ECM and stealth systems.
*armament &ndash; List of weaponry equipped.
*complement &ndash; Number and type of support craft carried aboard.
*bays &ndash; Number of docking bays or hangars.
*escapepods &ndash; Number and type of escape pods.
*crew &ndash; Number of crew (with crew breakdown if known).
*skeleton &ndash; Minimum crew required for operation.
*passengers &ndash; Number and type of passengers carried.
*capacity &ndash; Cargo capacity in metric tonnes.
*cargohandling &ndash; Number and type of systems for handling cargo.
*consumables &ndash; Duration of consumable goods stored aboard.
*lifesupport &ndash; Type of life-support systems.
*communications &ndash; Communications equipment.
*othersystems &ndash; Any systems not already listed in a specific parameter.
*role &ndash; Duties the ship is known to have performed. For example, command ship.
*commission &ndash; The date of the ship's commission.
*destroyed &ndash; The date of the ship's destruction.
*retired &ndash; The date of the ship's retirement.
*affiliation &ndash; List governments and/or major organizations who owned or controlled the ship.
*navy &ndash; The navies who owned or controlled the ship.
*fleet &ndash; The fleets owned or controlled the ship.
*owners &ndash; If ship is privately owned, list the owners here in chronological order.
*captains &ndash; List the ship's known commanding officers here in chronological order.
*registry &ndash; Relevant IDs used by the ship.
*aliases &ndash; Any alternate names used by the ship.
